papers.head: PRUITT'S · GAS · GIFTS · BAIT — HOME OF BIGFOOT

pages.text:
Marcy,

I've taken the kids to the shelter. If you find this, come straight there.

Do *NOT* go to the military checkpoint, they don't know what they're dealing with.

That witch has been burying things in the woods for weeks.

Rifle's in the safe, but she's empty, never found the right rounds. Combination's on my keys.

E.

Saw it again today, up the north ridge. Taller than any man, and it just watched me, calm as you like, then walked off into the trees without a sound. Sheriff laughed me out of the office. Marcy believes me though. That's enough.

Opened the store. Everyone thinks it's a gag, the signs, the casts, the photos. Let them. Keeps the lights on, and it keeps me out here, where I can watch.

Put trail cams up along the old logging trails this spring. If he's out there, I'll get him on film, and then they'll all stop laughing.

Seven years of watching, and I've stopped wanting to prove anything to anybody.

He came down to the creek at dusk again, near enough I could hear him breathing. Just sat there across the water with me a while, then went on his way.

Whatever he is, he's no danger to anyone. I've gotten fond of the big fella. I think he's been out here alone a long time.

Thirteen years of trail cams, and I've caught the big fella maybe twice, both times a blur. Suits us both fine. But this year I'm getting something else. Something fast.

Camera four, three nights running now, a shape going through the trees quicker than anything should move. Low to the ground, wrong somehow.

It isn't him. He's gentle. This thing isn't.

The lights started a few weeks back, out past the government land. Then the animals went quiet.

Camera four's got that fast shape every night now, closer to the road each time.

Checked the shelter today, restocked it, oiled the hatch. Dug that hole myself years ago, half as a joke. Hope to God I never need it.
